title: kedro
text: Kedro is an open-source Python framework for creating reproducible, maintainable and modular data science code.

title: pipeline
text: A Kedro pipeline is a collection of nodes that declare data dependencies. Kedro resolves the execution order from those dependencies.

title: catalog
text: The Kedro Data Catalog maps dataset names to storage backends so nodes can load and save data without hard-coded file paths.
